judgements.justification: No reviewer added an objection or changed a score after the response period; A's edits predate the responses and no score moved in either committee.
Both committees gave identical ratings (one 8, two 7s, one 6), so no rating gap exists for scoring leniency to explain.
No reviewer or AC called the headline claim or title overstated; skXW's concern was concurrent work matching the results, a novelty point, not an overstated claim.
A's reviewers were all at confidence 4 and gave 8, 7, 6, 7, not converged marginal-accept scores from reviewers unable to check the core.
